title: toxicodendron viminale
intro: Toxicodendron viminale, commonly known as Poison Sumac, is a flowering plant native to the southeastern United States and parts of South America. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, providing several health benefits such as reducing inflammation and treating skin conditions like eczema and dermatitis. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to inhibit the growth of microorganisms, making it effective in treating wounds and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Poison Sumac include gallic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
